import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    if K >= N:
        print(0)
        return
    C = N - K

    # precompute factorials up to 200000
    fac = [1] * 200001
    for i in range(1, 200001):
        fac[i] = (i * fac[i-1]) % MOD

    ans = 0
    sign = 1
    i = C
    while i > 0:
        val = (choose(C, i, fac) * pow(i, N, MOD)) % MOD
        ans = (ans + sign * val) % MOD
        sign = -sign
        i -= 1

    mult = 1 if C == N else (2 * choose(N, C, fac)) % MOD
    print((ans * mult) % MOD)

def choose(n, k, fac):
    den = (fac[k] * fac[n-k]) % MOD
    den_inv = pow(den, MOD-2, MOD)
    return (fac[n] * den_inv) % MOD

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
